voice.direction: Natural, warm, conversational and engaging. Never slowed for sadness, never sped up to fit. Never diagnoses the viewer.
voice.style: Warm, natural and conversational, lively and engaging, with clear articulation and no sleepy or theatrical delivery.

visual_identity.reference: owner's reference image (black round head, white crescent eyes, scribbled thoughts, glowing heart, soft dark room)
visual_identity.rive: NOT USED in this sample: no .riv asset exists in the repository and a .riv must be authored in Rive's editor. The rig exposes the same inputs (mood, lean, tilt, thought, heart) so a .riv drawn to these proportions can replace it. Owner decision needed.
visual_identity.graphics: restrained evidence graphics only where the research needs them

music.status: none in this sample: no licensed track has been fetched and vetted, so none is mixed in. Source and licence must be recorded for any track.

rules: show the feeling through the character and situation, not text
graphs only when they add real value
never diagnose or advise the viewer
every claim traces to a fetched source
